answer: Require every newcomer to moor at a public jetty where three established identities each co-sign an onyx guarantee of 30 POA, slashed if the newcomer is later proven to be a clone. Those guarantees cap how many newcomers any one identity can sponsor, so an attacker cannot route a thousand puppets through a single friendly account, and every sponsorship ties the guarantor's own standing to the newcomer's fate. The ledger replays each co-signature at every close, and an island of isolated guarantee clusters is flagged for audit before any spawns can vote.
